review_rules: Unpublished, cut and draft material is never labeled as shipped canon solely because it was authored during development.
Record project/game, draft date or build when known, author, and whether any portion survived into release.
When a draft differs from release, retain a development-delta relation instead of overwriting either version.
Concept-art annotations are textual evidence for development intent but visual inference should be marked separately.
Recovered or leaked provenance must be documented before ingestion; uncertain provenance remains quarantined.
